_comment: Per-caller Priority identities. COPY TO users.json AND FILL IN — the real file
Without users.json every caller shares the single Priority identity from .env,
so whoever holds the bearer token sees whatever that user can see. With it,
each caller presents their own token and every query they make runs under
their own Priority user, with that user's permissions.
Tokens must be at least 16 characters and unique; entries failing either are
skipped with a warning at startup rather than silently accepted.
MCP_AUTH_TOKEN keeps working alongside this and maps to the .env identity, so
adding this file does not lock out a client that already works.
